scope: Remote unit-test preflight before the rank-8 VACE retry
summary: The guard command stopped before training because tests/test_diffsynth_vace.py was not present on the remote checkout; no optimizer step ran.
evidence: Pytest returned code 4 with 'file or directory not found: tests/test_diffsynth_vace.py'.
The shell used an AND gate, so the training command was never executed.
lessons: A remote preflight must either synchronize its test target or run the already validated entrypoint directly.
limitations: This is a test-distribution failure, not a model or training failure.
next_actions: Launch the fixed entrypoint directly in a new directory while retaining full experiment metadata.
